what_this_is: PERCEPTUAL-FORMS-001F. Twelve synthetic controls whose ground truth is known BY
CONSTRUCTION: a donut has one hole because a hole was punched in it. Drawn by
THE COUNTS ARE UNDER ONE DECLARED PAIRING. `extent_forms.raster` pairs foreground
connected; `disconnected-fragments` exists to catch a producer that assumed the
other one. Reverse the pairing and half the numbers here change.
A HOLE COUNT NEEDS A CONVENTION. `holes` here is enclosed voids only; the
unbounded exterior is a complement component and is not a hole. Both numbers are
recorded per control so a producer can be checked against either.
SEPARATE FROM LANE C. `model_trials/controls/` holds IMAGE controls with alpha
truth, for asking whether a model can see. These hold PAYLOAD truth, for asking
whether a producer's record means what the form it fills says it means. Where a
scene exists in both, `also_see` points at it rather than redrawing it.

solid-mask.what: a filled rectangle with no voids and no pieces
solid-mask.the_trap: reporting a void, or a second fragment, where a rectangle was drawn

truth.holes_counted_as: enclosed voids only. The unbounded exterior is a complement component and is not a hole; `complement_components` carries the other count beside it
truth.note: a producer that reports a void here has found its own smoothing. A producer that reports two fragments has split a rectangle

donut.what: one piece with one enclosed void
donut.the_trap: drawing the inner ring like the outer one, so a hole reads as a second object

truth.holes_counted_as: enclosed voids only. The unbounded exterior is a complement component and is not a hole; `complement_components` carries the other count beside it
truth.note: the inner ring bounds a void. Drawn identically to the outer ring it reads as a second object rather than as a hole in the first

nested-holes.what: a void holding an island holding a void
nested-holes.the_trap: flattening the nesting into one piece with two voids

truth.holes_counted_as: enclosed voids only. The unbounded exterior is a complement component and is not a hole; `complement_components` carries the other count beside it
truth.note: two foreground pieces, one void each. A producer reporting one piece with two voids has flattened the nesting; a producer reporting one void has missed the inner one entirely

disconnected-fragments.what: five pieces, two of them touching only at a corner

truth.holes_counted_as: enclosed voids only. The unbounded exterior is a complement component and is not a hole; `complement_components` carries the other count beside it
truth.note: A and B share one corner and are TWO pieces under the declared pairing. A producer that reports four has assumed 8-connected foreground

disconnected-fragments.also_see: model_trials/controls/fence-tree.png tests the same form against an image

false-similarity.what: three identical discs, two of which belong together
false-similarity.the_trap: grouping on appearance, which gives one group of three

legitimate_groupings.why: A and B rest on one baseline; C is elsewhere in the frame

truth.note: all three are the same disc. A producer grouping on appearance gets one group of three, confidently and wrongly

soft-fringe.what: a scalar field with exact per-cell coverage
soft-fringe.the_trap: returning model confidence in place of fractional coverage

truth.note: fractional coverage, not confidence. A producer returning its own doubt will match on the core and miss the whole ramp

soft-fringe.also_see: model_trials/controls/soft-fog.png and hair-veil.png test the same distinction against images

partition.what: a figure behind a bar, running off the frame
partition.the_trap: assigning the off-frame pixels to visible or to inferred rather than to unknown

truth.note: the inferred part is exact because the figure was drawn before the bar covered it. The unknown part runs off the frame and is settled by nothing

density-peaks.what: two clusters and a stray, with exact positions
density-peaks.the_trap: smoothing the stray away and calling the count right

truth.note: the stray is deliberate. A producer that reports two clusters and drops it has a count error of one and a localisation error of nearly zero

containment-tree.what: A ⊃ B ⊃ C, A ⊃ D, and E outside everything
containment-tree.the_trap: forcing a single root, which invents a container for E

truth.note: E is contained by nothing and that is a measurement. A forest, not a tree — a producer that forces a single root has invented a container

adjacency-graph.what: a chain of four pieces, three related and three not
adjacency-graph.the_trap: rendering the three unrelated pairs as blank space, indistinguishable from unexamined

truth.note: six pairs examined, three edges recorded, three examined and unrelated. The two intersection fractions differ and neither is 'the' overlap

one-pixel-transition.what: a one-pixel gap, two real changes and one null
one-pixel-transition.the_trap: detecting the null, which more pixels moved than the real change

perturbations.why: one pixel closes the gap. A producer with any tolerance at all misses it
a change of kind, not of degree
sixteen pixels added, none of them near the gap. NOTHING about the relation changed, and a detection here is a false alarm

truth.note: one real one-pixel change, one real change of kind, one null with more pixels moved than the real one

competing-extents.what: a figure and its cast shadow — two legitimate extents
competing-extents.the_trap: collapsing to one answer, which scores the benchmark's tie-break

legitimate_readings.label: the figure itself
legitimate_readings.why: a shadow is cast BY the figure and is not part of its extent

legitimate_readings.label: the figure and what it casts
legitimate_readings.why: in a scene read as light and dark, the shadow belongs to the figure that throws it

truth.note: there is no truth mask here on purpose. A benchmark that picked one of these would be scoring its own tie-break, and the two readings are far enough apart that the choice dominates any IoU reported against a single answer
